newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers buck bearish European cargo market.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers buck bearish European cargo market.

text.p: ARA bunker prices remained aloof from a bearish cargo market as barges rose, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was quoted at around $111 fob as barges nudged $1 higher to the $108/$109 range.
Suppliers said ARA demand was almost non-existent, partly because buyers were aware of weakness at other European ports.
Hamburg prices remained tied to the ARA market, rising by $1 to around $121 fob. Unlike ARA, German dealers managed respectable volumes.
Bunkers were weaker in almost all Mediterranean ports.
Spanish prices were down $1 a tonne .
Demand in most areas was slight, although suppliers in Piraeus managed to close a couple of deals.
Further east, prices followed the bullish trend of Singapore. Fujairah was up by $2 to $112/$114 fob with a few enquiries.
Egyptian bunkers were also slightly firmer.
